column1: # lane declaration — who owns which territory, at which phase, and who outranks them.
# yields_to: comma-list of artifacts that outrank this one on THEIR territory, or -
# Two commands over one script, no skill: the judgment here is an exit code, not prose.
# stack-scan:plugin-scout owns marketplace-plugin-suggestion at understand — installing a
# PICKED set after reading the manifests. These rows own the unpicked set at ship, so the
# nouns and phases differ and pc_lanes_territory sees no pair; the hand-off ("want a
# curated set? that is /stack-scan:suggest") is stated in the README, not as a yields_to edge.
# The hint yields to install, the command it points at; phase any because a bare install is wrong at every point.
